response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js, cloud, and software craftsmanship credentials, plus recent hands-on exposure to MCP and agentic tooling at re:cinq. However, the role requires 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, and the resume shows only about 16 months of GenAI-adjacent work with no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, evaluation pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks — core requirements for a staff-level forward deployed GenAI role.
strengths: 15+ years of production software engineering across TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud (AWS CDK, Kubernetes)
Recent hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic workflow infrastructure
Proven communicator and mentor via workshops, conference talks, and consulting experience
concerns: Falls far short of the 8+ years of AI-driven solution development required
No demonstrated experience with RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent frameworks
Limited evidence of customer-facing technical discovery leadership at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Strong staff-level engineering and MCP/agentic exposure
